text:
Nora Kim: Heads-up: coordinated comms for DevTool launch tomorrow. Need a short playbook for owned channels + press/partner pings.
Diego Ramos: I can take owned channels (Twitter/LinkedIn) + tracking. Will need final headline + short link.
Priya Nair: I'll own press list & embargo notes. ETA for draft pitches: 2 hours.
LegalBot: Reminder: any metric claims must be backed by the benchmark appendix and legal sign-off required 4 hours before publish.
Nora Kim: Good call. Let's aim for conservative language on metrics and include benchmark link in kit.
Publish Bot: Scheduled publish: 2026-06-17 17:00:00 UTC. Draft URL: https://blog.redwood.inference/devtool-launch (placeholder).
Samir Patel: Social plan: 2 tweet variants, 1 LinkedIn long post, and a short Slack #announcements blurb. Who can approve copy quickly?
Design Bot: I can deliver hero image + stat badge by 06:00 PT if copy is frozen by then.
Priya Nair: Press embargo lift: 2026-06-17 17:00:00 UTC. I'll send embargoed kit to top outlets 24 hours prior. Use embargo code EMB-DEV-17.
Nora Kim: UTMs: utm_source=owned, utm_campaign=devtool_launch, utm_medium={channel}. Diego please apply.
Diego Ramos: Will do. Also prepping a short email to partners to offer demos next week.
Sales Ops: Please include a single-slide talking points doc and trial offer details — we need that in the internal comm.
Priya Nair: Outreach template (short): "Hi {name}, we're releasing a deep-dive on DevTool tomorrow. It reduces median inference latency in internal tests—details inside. Would you like an embargoed copy?"
LegalBot: Approveable copy must include: "based on internal benchmark results" for metric sentences.
Samir Patel: Draft #announcements copy: "New: DevTool — production inference optimizations. Blog + benchmarks: [link]". Short and factual.
Design Bot: Confirming hero will include a small, non-sensational stat badge (if metrics approved).
Nora Kim: Action items recap: Diego  social + UTMs; Priya  press + embargo sends; Design  assets; Legal  sign-off; Sales Ops  internal slide. Please update status in this thread as completed.
Samir Patel: I'll queue the internal comm to Sales & CS for 30 minutes post-publish with talking points and trial link.
Priya Nair: I'll drop the embargoed press kit into /marketing/press/devtool_kit/ once Legal signs off.
Nora Kim: Thanks everyone. If we see coverage early, paste links here. Keep language humble and verified. :seedling:
